Maine aapka code check kiya hai. Aapke **`Login.jsx`** file mein line 21 pe yeh code likha hua hai:
```javascript
const res = await fetch(`${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'https://odizopetcare.onrender.com'}${endpoint}`, ...
```
Dhyan se dekhiye, yahan par aapne ek **"fallback"** (backup) lagaya hua hai: `|| 'https://odizopetcare.onrender.com'`. 
Iska matlab hai ki agar Vercel ko `VITE_API_URL` nahi milta (jo ki sach mein nahi mil raha), toh woh automatically `https://odizopetcare.onrender.com` ko use kar leta hai. Isliye Vercel pe login successful ho jata hai!

Lekin agar hum **`MyPets.jsx`** (aur baaki files) mein dekhein, toh wahan backup link nahi diya gaya hai. Wahan code kuch aisa hai:
```javascript
const res = await fetch(`${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL}/api/imagekit/upload`, ...
```
Yahan par koi backup link (`||`) nahi hai. Jab Vercel yahan `VITE_API_URL` dhundta hai, usko kuch nahi milta (undefined). Toh request galat URL pe chali jaati hai aur fail ho jaati hai (isliye JSON error aata hai aur pets load/upload nahi hote).

**Solution:**
Aap chahein toh har file mein jaake woh backup link (`|| 'https://odizopetcare.onrender.com'`) add kar sakte hain... **LEKIN yeh sahi tareeqa nahi hai** aur bohot time waste hoga.

Sabse best aur professional tareeqa wahi hai jo maine pehle bataya:
Aap bas **Vercel Dashboard** mein jaake `Environment Variables` ke andar apna `VITE_API_URL` = `https://odizopetcare.onrender.com` add karke project ko redeploy kar dijiye. Isse poori website ki har file ko automatically pata chal jayega ki backend kahan hai!
